captions.text: Start from a fresh NodeSlide landing — one idea, no recycled deck.
Attach the PRD, TDD, measured metrics, research notes, and design direction.
Choose a named model and consent now. Web research will ask for its own separate consent.
NodeSlide compiles that evidence into a new six-slide, editable founder roadshow.
Text, charts, math, images, and diagrams stay native — never flattened into slide screenshots.
Select one element and ask the agent for one bounded change.
The candidate is validated and compared before a human accepts it.
Refine one slide with separately consented web research and bound source evidence.
Select exactly two slides and grant exactly that write scope — not the whole deck.
Edit chart labels and values in a native data grid, then review the resulting patch.
The north-star formula is a real editable math primitive.
Layout remains structured too: move and resize elements without flattening the slide.
Replace an image with a rights-cleared file, alt text, and visible credit.
Trace ties model work, validation, cost, timestamps, and source lineage to the accepted result.
Deck memory preserves a scoped standing preference for future long-running work.
Present in the app, then publish a frozen validated version for review.
Finish with editable PowerPoint and validated JSON — the story remains portable and inspectable.
